question: What culmination is reached by chanting Tripurasundarī nine hundred thousand times?
premises: Tripurasundarī is chanted to the measure of nine hundred thousand.
This represents the highest count in the sequence.
The result of this practice is described in the next verse.
inference: Chanting Tripurasundarī nine hundred thousand times leads to the supreme attainment described next.
uncertainties: Whether tripurasundarīm names the mantra or the deity directly is context-dependent.
plain_english: And having chanted Tripurasundarī to the measure of nine hundred thousand times—
